entries.source_title: SEC Release 34-102437 (SR-OCC-2025-002), Exhibit 5: OCC Schedule of Fees — flat $0.025/contract, no per-trade cap (replaced tiered $0.02 / $55-cap schedule)
SR-OCC-2025-019 Exhibit 5A: December 2025 fee holiday ($0.00/contract Dec 1-31, 2025)
SR-OCC-2025-019 Exhibit 5A: reversion to $0.025/contract on the first trading day of 2026

notes: theocc.com is behind a Cloudflare challenge; rates verified from OCC's own SEC rule filings, which reproduce the Schedule of Fees verbatim.

SR-OCC-2025-002 was initially filed effective 2025-01-01 and refiled effective 2025-02-14; OCC's later filing states 'Beginning in January 2025, OCC increased its clearing fee to $0.025 per contract.'

Pre-2025 tiered schedule ($0.02/contract <=2,750 contracts; $55 flat above) is not encoded: dates before 2025-01-01 raise, blocking any historical options backtest until that schedule is added with citations.
All entries compiled 2026-08-10 from the cited primary sources.
